thread:
Kevin: quick heads up — opened a terraform PR to change Karpenter provisioner weights + add a taint to prefer spot nodes. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/pull/842

Zara: can you paste the provisioner snippet? want to check how it interacts with HPA scale-up timing

Kevin: sure, here's the relevant terraform + k8s snippet from the PR:
```
resource "aws_launch_template" "spot_lt" {
  # ...
  instance_market_options { market_type = "spot" }
}

kubernetes_manifest "karpenter_provisioner" {
  manifest = <<YAML
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1alpha5
kind: Provisioner
spec:
  provider:
    instanceTypes: ["m6i.large","m6i.xlarge"]
  taints:
    - key: "prefer/spot"
      value: "true"
      effect: "PreferNoSchedule"
  weight: 70
  consolidation:
    enabled: true
YAML
}
```

Alex: hmm `PreferNoSchedule` is just a preference. Are pods tolerating that taint? if not they'll never land on spot nodes. we should add a toleration to the deployment or set `PreferNoSchedule` -> `PreferNoExecute`? :thinking_face:

Kevin: pods have tolerations for `spot` in the chart, but I forgot to confirm the HPA-managed pods actually carry them (some sidecar changes). planning to add toleration via helm values in the PR.

Jamie: past incidents — when karpenter shifts to spot-heavy nodes we saw HPA thrash because scale-up is slower and HPA short stabilization made it overscale then crash. suggest bumping `stabilizationWindowSeconds` and `behavior` block.

Zara: I agree. Also worth setting an HPA `minReplicas` bump for the deployment while we migrate. share a suggested HPA patch?

Alex: quick HPA patch we usually use for these migrations:
```
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
spec:
  minReplicas: 4
  maxReplicas: 40
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 60
  behavior:
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 120
      policies:
      - type: Percent
        value: 200
        periodSeconds: 60
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
      policies:
      - type: Percent
        value: 50
        periodSeconds: 300
```

Zara: yup add that to the PR as an overlay or a conditional in helm values. Also make sure VPA isn't configured to evict pods aggressively; set `updatePolicy: "Off"` for now if VPA exists.

Kevin: good call. VPA is enabled in staging for that deployment. I'll set `updatePolicy: Off` and add the toleration.

infra-bot: CI check — terraform plan for PR #842 completed: 0 errors, changes: +1 provisioner, +1 launch_template. plan id: plan-20260317-58

Jamie: quick verification steps before merging:
- apply the karpenter provisioner to staging via `kubectl apply -f` (dry-run first)
- bump HPA in staging and run load test (k6 quick 30s) to observe scale-up latency
- watch for pod pending events and `Insufficient` events in node-controller logs

Kevin: plan to do those tonight after 8pm PST. tagging @Zara @Alex for quick review when I push the helm change.

Zara: I'll review after 8:30. if we see flapping we can temporarily disable consolidation on this prov since that was the cause previously. :thumbsup:

Alex: also add an annotation on the provisioner to set `karpenter.sh/ttl-after-empty: "30s"` to reclaim small empty nodes faster — saves cost during tests.

Kevin: noted. I'll push updates and ping this thread once applied. thanks all.
